subject: Math
skill: Ratios Rates Proportional Relationships And Units
prompt: A machine produces plastic pellets at a constant rate of $15$ grams per minute. At this rate, what is the time, in minutes, that it would take the machine to produce $105$ grams of plastic pellets?
explanation: Choice A is correct. If the machine produces $105$ grams at a rate of $15$ grams per minute, the time required can be determined by dividing the total quantity by the rate. This results in $\frac{105 \text{ grams}}{15 \text{ grams}/\text{minute}}$, which is $7$ minutes.
